containers.name: pv-labutils
containers.description: Flashing, power-switching, serial and shell tooling for a Pantacor lab controller container.

containers.name: pv-avahi
containers.description: mDNS/service discovery container, also used as an xconnect pvtest fixture.

containers.name: pvwificonnect
containers.description: Manages Wi-Fi connections, including BLE and hotspot provisioning, on Pantacor-enabled devices.

containers.name: pv-avahi-browse
containers.description: mDNS browse consumer over a hosted D-Bus system bus, also used as an xconnect pvtest fixture.

containers.name: pv-netbench
containers.description: Measures Pantahub network usage and publishes it as device-meta.

containers.name: pv-alpine-connman
containers.description: Alpine-based ConnMan network manager container, fetched prebuilt from the pv-platforms registry.

containers.name: pv-alpine-dbus
containers.description: Hosted D-Bus system bus container, pulled prebuilt from Docker Hub (asac/alpine-dbus).

containers.name: pv-awconnect
containers.description: Legacy WiFi provisioning appliance container, fetched prebuilt from the pv-platforms registry. No arm32v6 asset is published, so docker-armv6 is excluded.

containers.name: pv-debian-nm
containers.description: Debian-based NetworkManager container, fetched prebuilt from the pv-platforms registry. Only an amd64 asset is published, so this targets docker-x86_64 only.

containers.name: pv-pvr-sdk
containers.description: Pantavisor pvr SDK container, fetched prebuilt from the pv-platforms registry.

containers.name: pv-pvsm
containers.description: Pantavisor state machine (pvsm) container, fetched prebuilt from the pvsm registry.

containers.name: pv-pvwificonnect
containers.description: WiFi Connect container fetched prebuilt from the pvwificonnect registry, as distinct from the pvwificonnect container built from source in this same list.

containers.name: pv-tailscale
containers.description: Tailscale VPN container, fetched prebuilt from the ph-tailscale registry.
